verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes a documented public web API (docs.sentry.io/api/) for managing organizations, teams, and exporting data, and additionally ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants search, triage, and manage Sentry programmatically. However, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, limiting machine-readability for automated agent tooling. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/schema definition, independent hands-on verification of API usage by an AI agent.
